description: GRC IsBootSecure: Checks whether Windows booted in UEFI mode, whether Secure Boot is enabled, and whether the firmware Platform Key is known to be unsafe.
notes: GRC does not publish a static SHA-256 checksum for this download. The manifest omits hash rather than inventing a value.
Recent utility; review its report and your OEM firmware updates if an unsafe Secure Boot key is detected.

script: if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Unable to read the published Last Updated date for IsBootSecure.' }
